releaseNotes: Study notes grow into a full eight-section workbook: every curated passage now carries its overview, historical background, literary context, verse-by-verse observations, original-language terms, Scripture cross-references, clearly-present teachings, and questions to carry — each with native Amharic. Each note opens with a memory anchor card, and the bundled study bank was migrated to the new workbook schema with validation that treats any drift as a release-blocking failure.
